def control(obs):
    hitch = obs.get('hitch_deg', 0.0)
    route = obs.get('route', {})
    bearing = route.get('bearing_deg', 0.0)
    target = max(-22.0, min(22.0, 1.1 * bearing))
    steer = max(-34.0, min(34.0, 2.2 * (hitch - target)))
    return (steer, -0.8)

def control(obs):
    h = obs.get('hitch_deg', 0.0)
    route = obs.get('route', {})
    b = route.get('bearing_deg', 0.0)
    target_h = max(-18.0, min(18.0, b * 0.8))
    steer = max(-35.0, min(35.0, 1.6 * (h - target_h)))
    return (steer, -1.0, 180)

def control(obs):
    h = obs.get('hitch_deg', 0.0)
    route = obs.get('route', {})

    return (steer, -1.0, 180)
